CASE STUDY • AI Product Builder • June 2026

Digital Timesheet System

A digital alternative to paper tutor timesheets, automatically calculating daily, weekly, and monthly work hours and producing a downloadable PDF.

Overview Problem My Role Process Solution Results & Learnings
TARGET USERS & AUDIENCE

Academic tutors recording shift hours and supervisors reviewing timesheet records at the Student Success Center.

THE PROBLEM

The manual paper process for logging hours required calculating daily and monthly totals by hand and handling physical sheets, creating an everyday administrative burden.

MY ROLE

I identified the need, worked out the exact information tutors needed to record, and designed, built, and refined the MVP as a usable operational tool.

WHAT WAS DESIGNED & BUILT

A functional web timesheet MVP that captures date, day, time in, time out, and total hours, supports automated hour calculations with weekly and monthly totals, and generates a downloadable PDF. (Sending the PDF directly to a supervisor is an ongoing improvement).

OUTCOMES & RECOGNITION

Operational MVP — Successfully transformed a manual paper workflow into a working digital MVP.

Explore Case Study
01 // CONTEXT

Overview

While working as a tutor at Livingstone College’s Student Success Center, I experienced the paper process for recording work hours. I built a digital alternative designed directly around that real workflow.

Core Objective: Delivering a functional, high-value solution addressing verified real-world needs at Livingstone College and beyond.
02 // THE CHALLENGE

Problem Statement

The manual paper process for logging hours required calculating daily and monthly totals by hand and handling physical sheets, creating an everyday administrative burden.

Affected Stakeholders

Academic tutors recording shift hours and supervisors reviewing timesheet records at the Student Success Center.

03 // OWNERSHIP

My Role & Responsibility

I identified the need, worked out the exact information tutors needed to record, and designed, built, and refined the MVP as a usable operational tool.

Key Competencies Demonstrated: Problem Discovery, User-Centered Design, Technical Execution, and Rapid MVP Delivery.
04 // METHODOLOGY

Process & Execution

1

Observed firsthand friction points in the Student Success Center paper timesheet workflow.

2

Identified essential recording fields: date, day, time in, time out, and total hours.

3

Designed and built an MVP with automated hour calculations across shifts.

4

Added calculations for weekly and monthly hour totals.

5

Implemented a downloadable PDF export feature for required record-keeping.

05 // DELIVERABLE

Solution & Core Features

A functional web timesheet MVP that captures date, day, time in, time out, and total hours, supports automated hour calculations with weekly and monthly totals, and generates a downloadable PDF. (Sending the PDF directly to a supervisor is an ongoing improvement).

Applied Technologies & Methods
Web DevelopmentUI DesignAutomated CalculationsPDF Generation
Interface Specification: Desktop and mobile screens of the working timesheet interface and downloadable PDF output.
06 // IMPACT & REFLECTION

Results & Learnings

Successfully transformed a manual paper workflow into a working digital MVP.

Automated calculations for daily hours as well as weekly and monthly totals.

Created downloadable PDF timesheet records reflecting the required institutional format.

KEY TAKEAWAYS & LESSONS LEARNED

"How to take ownership of an everyday operational problem, identify essential user requirements, and build a practical, functioning digital tool."
